column1: # A site belongs here when a broad catch WITHOUT a preceding
# because the guarded `try` contains no suspension point, and a `suspend`
# function that never suspends never takes delivery of cooperative cancellation.
# It does NOT belong here because it has not been looked at yet. That is what
# scripts/cancellation-catch-backlog.tsv is for, and the difference between the
# two files is the difference between "safe" and "not fixed".
#   path        repo-relative path of the Kotlin file
#   function    enclosing function, as the scanner names it (see
#   count       how many unguarded broad catches that <path, function> has
#   reason      why, in one line, >= 20 characters
# The count is an EXACT match against the tree, in both directions: fixing a
# site fails the gate until this file is updated. Keyed on the function rather
# than the line so that ordinary edits above it do not churn the file.

column4: No suspension point in the try: the sole production CertificateStore impl delegates to a non-suspend atomicWrite. Pinned by IntegrationSecretsPersistCancellationTest, which fails naming this site if atomicWrite becomes suspending. Reasoning is written out in full at the site.
